statement: The function returns a result r. Let S be the set of positive integers z such that (z & x) == x, where & denotes bitwise AND on 64-bit integers. Then r is the n-th smallest element of S. Equivalently, (r & x) == x and the number of positive integers z with z < r and (z & x) == x is exactly n - 1.
preconditions: n and x are 64-bit integers with 1 <= n <= 10^8 and 1 <= x <= 10^8.

statement: When the function returns r, there exists an array a of length n of positive integers such that a is strictly increasing, the bitwise AND of all a[i] for 0 <= i < n equals x, and a[n-1] = r.
preconditions: n and x are 64-bit integers with 1 <= n <= 10^8 and 1 <= x <= 10^8.

statement: When the function returns r, for every array a of length n of positive integers that is strictly increasing and whose bitwise AND equals x, we have a[n-1] >= r.
preconditions: n and x are 64-bit integers with 1 <= n <= 10^8 and 1 <= x <= 10^8.

statement: When the function returns r, we have r >= x.
preconditions: n and x are 64-bit integers with 1 <= n <= 10^8 and 1 <= x <= 10^8.

statement: When the function returns r and n > 1, we have r > x.
preconditions: n and x are 64-bit integers with 1 <= n <= 10^8, 1 <= x <= 10^8, and n > 1.

statement: When the function returns r, (r & x) == x.
preconditions: n and x are 64-bit integers with 1 <= n <= 10^8 and 1 <= x <= 10^8.

statement: When the function returns r, the number of positive integers z with z <= r and (z & x) == x is exactly n.
preconditions: n and x are 64-bit integers with 1 <= n <= 10^8 and 1 <= x <= 10^8.

statement: When the function returns r, for any positive integer r', if (r' & x) == x and the number of positive integers z with z <= r' and (z & x) == x is exactly n, then r' = r.
preconditions: n and x are 64-bit integers with 1 <= n <= 10^8 and 1 <= x <= 10^8.

statement: Let r1 be the result of min_end(n1, x) and r2 be the result of min_end(n2, x). Then r1 < r2.
preconditions: x is a 64-bit integer with 1 <= x <= 10^8, and n1, n2 are 64-bit integers with 1 <= n1 < n2 <= 10^8.

statement: When the function returns r, for every bit position i with 0 <= i < 64: if the i-th bit of x is 1 then the i-th bit of r is 1; if the i-th bit of x is 0 and j is the number of zero bits of x below i, then the i-th bit of r equals the j-th bit of (n - 1).
preconditions: n and x are 64-bit integers with 1 <= n <= 10^8 and 1 <= x <= 10^8.

statement: When the function returns r, there exists an array a of length n of positive integers such that a[0] = x, a is strictly increasing, the bitwise AND of all a[i] equals x, and a[n-1] = r.
preconditions: n and x are 64-bit integers with 1 <= n <= 10^8 and 1 <= x <= 10^8.

statement: When the function returns r, there exists an array a of length n of positive integers such that for every i with 0 <= i < n, a[i] is the (i+1)-th smallest element of S = {z > 0 : (z & x) == x}, and a[n-1] = r.
preconditions: n and x are 64-bit integers with 1 <= n <= 10^8 and 1 <= x <= 10^8.

statement: The function returns a result r for every n, x satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: n and x are 64-bit integers with 1 <= n <= 10^8 and 1 <= x <= 10^8.
